purpose: Illustrative 3D Earth opening scene, not a live-weather map or temperature-analysis result.
credit: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA Goddard Space Flight Center; Reto Stöckli and Robert Simmon.
context: Day surface: July 2004 Blue Marble Next Generation. Clouds and city-light composite: original Blue Marble collection; illustrative layers are not synchronized to the analysis period or the current date.
changes: Original downloaded images are unmodified. Lighting, cloud transparency and compositing are applied in the 3D scene.
code_assistance: Scene implementation prepared with AI assistance from OpenAI Codex. Image textures are NASA source imagery, not AI-generated.
